pilot_core.status: Verified exact author-code extraction; directly usable affine synthesis/buffer core with caller-specified nominal size. No startup data introduced.
pilot_core.maximum_scale_interpretation: Bounds of the supplied scenario, not a universal technological limit or evidence for unlimited linear scale-up.
pilot_core.heat_status: Reference Aspen heat-integrated process has zero net external heating; not a claim of zero gross reboiler duty or a fitted exportable-heat coefficient.
source_locators: GAMS lines 90-93: Ramp_Constr=0.05, Min_load_MEOH=0.2, reference capacity 9935 kg/h.
arXiv section 5.2 minimum-load/no-shutdown/ramp discussion, main.tex lines 382-411; Appendix A.4, main.tex lines 671-695 and Table A.3. Final journal section 5.2, pages 7-8, Tables 4-5.
must_not_import_from_giehl: No standing H2 inventory-loss factor appears in the author Mucci balance; modeled hourly retention is 1.0, not the ambiguous Giehl percentage.
No Giehl raw/refined-MeOH conversion ratio or Giehl methanol LHV is needed for the mass-based Mucci constraints.
The 0.1847 electricity coefficient excludes upstream electrolysis and upstream H2 compression; keep those separate.
Cooling duty must not be counted as electricity without an independently specified cooling-system model.

input_calibration.active_GAMS_import: Power_Price.xlsx: Day-ahead!A2:B1441; column A index, B electricity price
input_calibration.hour_indices_verified: All four sheets have 1440 observations with indices 1..1440.
input_calibration.timestamp_mapping: Workbook contains integer hour indices, not explicit timestamps or timezone. Do not invent exact UTC/DST correspondence.

continuous_reduction.exact_affine_core: Fix nominal synthesis size and buffer volume; use the pilot_core equations. This reproduces the synthesis constraints and inventory balance, but not the complete upstream author MINLP.
continuous_reduction.native_H2_loss_retained: No standing-loss term; do not import Giehl loss.
continuous_reduction.optional_cyclic_H2_terminal: S_T=S_0 is a separate explicit modeling variant, not an original constraint.
continuous_reduction.upstream_LP_caution: PEM 0-or-minimum-load disjunction, pressure-dependent compression and nonlinear efficiency are not exact continuous-LP constraints. Continuous epigraph PWL requires a tightness condition; SOS2 graph enforcement is not a pure LP.
continuous_reduction.objective_caution: Fixed-throughput cost minimization is an LP after affine approximation, but differs from unconstrained levelized-cost minimization. Fixed-design native LCOM is linear-fractional and can be solved by LP-based fractional programming. Joint nonlinear CAPEX design is not a single LP.
continuous_reduction.numerical_approximation_validation: Detailed independent reduction and approximation-error checks are recorded in mucci_process_model_audit_20261002.md; no pilot reduction has been integrated or claimed as author-calibrated.

independently_derived_PWL_example.status: Optional mathematical approximation derived solely from author polynomial; not author-supplied knots, not the pilot calibration, and not implemented.
independently_derived_PWL_example.inverse_PWL_equation: P_hat(q)=max_j(a_j*q+b_j), with q in kg/h and P in MW, only on the specified ON-domain.
independently_derived_PWL_example.validation_method: For each chord, evaluate the cubic power-error function at endpoints and all real derivative roots within the segment; relative-error extrema evaluated analytically. Floating-point negative endpoint residuals are below 1.1e-14 MW.
independently_derived_PWL_example.LP_epigraph_constraints: P>=a_j*q+b_j for all j, 473.1006931875<=q<=1904.8215, 21<=P<=100. This enforces an epigraph, not equality; require objective/constraint tightness or replay validation.
independently_derived_PWL_example.off_state_caution: Fixing the electrolyzer ON restricts the native model. Adding an origin-to-minimum chord admits fractional-hour operation below the native minimum and is an explicit relaxation. Neither is an exact reproduction of the native binary disjunction.

independently_derived_compressor_approxi.status: Optional fixed maximum-pressure conservative energy-demand approximation; not an author replacement model.
independently_derived_compressor_approxi.caution: Conservative compressor electricity at low inventory can be about 119% too high. Do not claim this is a precise pressure-dependent model or a physical-feasibility upper-bound relaxation.

numerical_checks.compressor_validation_scope: Four published points at 1900 kg/h and 40-bar inlet, not independent low-load transient validation.

known_source_discrepancies: Paper/supplement round MeOH ratios; exact supplied GAMS uses 0.19124 H2/kg MeOH, 0.1847 electric, 1.3844 cooling and 1.5494 CO2 per tonne MeOH.
Paper nominal PEM minimum 25% (0.5 MW/module), while supplied GAMS uses 0.525 MW/module (26.25% of nominal).
Paper design bounds are broader than the recovered single GAMS scenario: N=10..40 and p_PEM=20..40 bar versus code 35..40 and 35..40 bar.
arXiv v1 vessel upper bound 5000 m3; final journal Table 4 upper bound 7500 m3; recovered GAMS 800..1500 m3.
Supplement prints battery cost 368 USD/MWh; code 0.368 MUSD/MWh and final journal Table A.5 368 USD/kWh agree with each other, not that literal supplement unit.
Supplement annualization uses 8000 h; code 48*7*24=8064 h.
GAMS LCOM comment MEUR/kt is dimensionally inconsistent with its denominator in million kg; the numerical objective is EUR/kg.
Article CC BY 4.0 is verified; an explicit software reuse grant for the GAMS member was not found.
